description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelCheck class, a PHP class extending SugarWidgetField, responsible for rendering checkbox widgets in a subpanel list within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It includes logic to display checkboxes based on various conditions, such as the type of widget and its value.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelCheck
classes.description: A class extending SugarWidgetField used for rendering checkbox elements in subpanel lists within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Generates and returns HTML code for displaying a checkbox or a value in a list, depending on the layout definition and the type of widget.
